title: Guruch qozoni omadsiz chiqqan firma nimaga aylandi?
hook: 1946 yilda yigirmatadan kam xodimli firma ochildi.

scenes.text: 1946 yilda Tokioda urushdan keyingi vayronalar orasida yigirmatadan kam xodimli kichik firma ochildi.
scenes.keywords: old city ruins black and white

scenes.text: Ularning ilk urinishlaridan biri elektr guruch qozoni edi. Guruch goh xom, goh kuyib chiqardi. Qozon yaxshi sotilmadi.
Ular to'xtamadi. Radio va magnitofon kabi buyumlarni ta'mirlash va yasashga o'tishdi.
Asoschilar Masaru Ibuka va Akio Morita edi. 1958 yilda kompaniya nomi Sony bo'ldi.
Omadsiz qozon bilan boshlangan firma dunyoga tanilgan elektronika brendiga aylandi.

description:
Masaru Ibuka va Akio Morita 1946 yilda Tokioda Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo kompaniyasini yigirmatadan kam xodim bilan tuzgan. Ilk urinishlaridan biri, elektr guruch qozoni, omadsiz chiqqan. 1958 yilda kompaniya nomi Sony bo'lgan.

Sizda ham omadsiz birinchi urinish bo'lganmi? Izohda yozing.
source: Web fact-check 2026-11-20 (web search summaries; sony.com and Wikipedia could not be opened from this session). Britannica 'Sony' (Tokyo Tsushin Kogyo founded 7 May 1946 by Ibuka and Morita, first consumer product an electric rice cooker, Sony name official January 1958); Wikipedia 'History of Sony' and Tokyo Weekender (bomb-damaged Shirokiya building in Nihonbashi, capital 190,000 yen; employee count varies by source: 8, fewer than 20, about 20); Business Today India (cooker over- or undercooked rice). Exact headcount and 'sold nothing' are not confirmed by an official page, so the text now says 'yigirmatadan kam xodim' and 'yaxshi sotilmadi' / 'omadsiz'.
